planets.name: XO-5 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Absolutno with a 4.19-day year, found in 2008.

text.card: XO-5 b was found in 2008 by XO as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Absolutno. Its orbit and size follow Smith 2015's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname SMITH_2015): disc_year 2008, disc_facility XO, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.18775631, pl_radj 1.14, pl_bmassj 1.19

quotes.title: XO-5b
quotes.card: XO-5b, formally named Makropulos, is an extrasolar planet approximately 910 light years away in the constellation of Lynx.
quotes.introduction: This planet was found by the transit method using the XO Telescope and announced in May 2008.
